experiment: SD 1.5 depth ControlNet plus single-reference IP-Adapter gate
purpose: Test whether the passed dense human depth structure can coexist with one approved Mira appearance reference before adding LoRA, a second reference, or local repairs.

inputs.structure_guide: Pose Depot 2F_Hand_on_Hip/Depth.png; temporary Apache-2.0 input, not retained

fixed_runtime.pipeline: StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline with model CPU offload and VAE slicing

comparison.result: Depth preserved a coherent single high-angle three-quarter body with two legs and two feet. The teal bob and watercolor-like line treatment appeared, but the white jacket became a cyan top, and the navy flap bag plus diagonal strap were absent.

The result remained nearly the same. Stronger appearance conditioning did not restore the white jacket, navy flap bag, or single diagonal strap, and did not improve the character face enough to claim identity consistency.

reason: This pairing can execute on 8 GB and can carry broad color and rendering cues, but it does not meet the Mira identity and object contract while the dense depth structure is active. Do not run additional IP-Adapter scale sweeps or add scene controls to this branch.
removed_artifacts: Temporary SD 1.5 depth ControlNet and IP-Adapter downloads
